disposition_reason: Twenty-four elements including mercury, arsenic, cadmium and lead were quantified in farmed Mediterranean mussel soft tissue in two sessions.

study.design: trace element monitoring of farmed mussels at an experimental suspended-rope pilot farm, two sampling sessions
study.origin: experimental pilot mussel farm, Calich Lagoon, Porto Conte Regional Natural Park, north-west Sardinia, Italy
study.period_text: February and May 2019 (farm running December 2018 to May 2019)
study.method: Hg by direct mercury analyser (DMA80); 23 other elements by ICP-MS (Thermo Xseries II) after microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion
study.lod_text: LOQ 0.010 mg/kg for Hg and for ICP-MS elements
study.qa: NIST SRM 1566b oyster tissue, recoveries 82-104%; three measurements per sample
